g.text: TASTE IN THIS ORDER, MILD TO BOLD
Start mild. 100% cashew, no added salt or oil.
Made with real fruit. Sweet and chewy.
Sweet, sour, with rock salt and spices.
On fresh fruit. Tangy, salty, a little wild.
Finish with a cup. Brewed strong. Poured slow.
Take it home, or make it
ALLERGEN ADVICE · Cashews and other dry fruits are tree nuts. Everything is packed in a facility that also handles tree nuts and peanuts.
